## Public engagement initiatives

### SUCRE programme

From 2016 - present. *Supported by the Research Promotion Plan UJI (Refs UJI-B2020-31 and UJI-B2022-64) and [Fundación Española para la Ciencia y la Tecnología](https://www.fecyt.es/) (Refs FCT-19-15198 and FCT-23-19666)*

The [Sucre Program](https://www.sucre.uji.es/newsite/) is an initiative of GEOTEC and Universitat Jaume I that promotes computational thinking and programming among pre-university students. It involves block-based programming starting in primary school, and the use of physical cards for children in preschool.



### Jean Monnet Chair for EU BlueCrime and Ocean Governance

From October 2026 to September 2029. *Supported by the Research Promotion Plan UJI 2025–2026, specifically through Program 5.2 – Research Networks at Universitat Jaume I. Ref EIXARXES/2025/03*

The Jean Monnet Action EU BlueCrime and Ocean Governance ([EU BLUECRIME-GOV](https://bluecrimegov.uji.es/)) supports teaching, research, and public engagement on European Union environmental criminal law, maritime governance, marine protection, and ocean-related environmental harm.

The Chair is designed to connect academic work with legal and policy debates on environmental crime, coastal risk, marine ecosystems, and European approaches to ocean governance.

### Blue Governance Laboratory (BlueGovLab)
From January 2025 to December 2026

[BlueGovLab](https://bluegovlab.uji.es/) supports interdisciplinary collaboration on ocean governance, marine biodiversity, environmental protection, maritime security, and public policy.

Its knowledge-exchange activities connect researchers from different disciplines with public authorities, civil-society organisations, environmental professionals, and actors working in the blue economy.
